author: Rogueblawd
body: So someone on walls decided it was funny to sit on a skybase for an hour (this is still going on as of posting) . And the only alive players thought it was funny while over 10 players waited. There's only 2 or 3 working walls servers, so I think we really need a time limit for this.

replies.author: potatoarmor
replies.body:
With a height limit of 150 people could stand on the ground with a powerful bow and pick off people in skybases.  You have to let skybases be higher than max bow height (around y = 155).  That is why I say 175.  If you are in a skybase at that height and shoot at somebody who can reach you, if they fall they should die from fall damage.

And of course if you are doing this, fix fire so it can spread and make it so that leaves decay again.  Fire spreading is a big thing, changes the game with fire not spreading.

replies.author: Rogueblawd
replies.body:
Did you read my post?

All servers were in process, so I figured I'd wait for the one furthest in. Most of the time all of the servers are in process or none are. All alive players in this particular game thought it was funny to make people wait. Luckily a mod came and ended the game.

I don't think I'm being unfair. Original wall rules state (from Hypixel's original mcf post) that building above the walls is prohibited.

And it's not anyone else's job to go after the skybaser. If anything, he should come down.
